descriptionMarkdown:
Spirit Guardian; Allies within 10 ft of you gain advantage on saving throws against fear while you are conscious.

Spirit Guardian; When you reduce damage with Rune Ward, the target also gains temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

Spirit Guardian; Allies protected by your Rune Ward also gain advantage on the next fear or psychic saving throw they make before your next turn.

Spirit Guardian; When Rune Ward protects an ally, one hostile creature within 30 ft has disadvantage on its next psychic saving throw.
